name: Advanced Settings UI V1.6
summary: Runtime-built settings interface with theme/font choices, audio controls, visual options and accessibility preferences.
install: Move SettingsUi ScreenGui from Settings Panel into StarterGui. Keep SettingsButton and all embedded LocalScripts. ThumbnailCamera is a preview helper. Configure the main Settings script and wire any game-specific preferences to your own systems; review SoundService group names before use.
limits: Original runtime-generated layout retained. Local visual/audio preference handling is not proof of persistent settings or game-wide integration. Mobile/gamepad testing remains unverified. Known supplied-code bug: click-sound callback calls a nil playClickSound function at line 291. Tabs render, but this is not a fully working release.
credit: Original supplied version label and embedded source are retained.
verification: Limited Studio Play check: original LocalScript generated the interface; overview/audio/graphics/interface/style tabs were visited. Top and bottom scroll states are captured. Known supplied-code error: Settings line 291 calls playClickSound as a nil value on clicks (function scoping/order issue). Navigation still displayed, but the pack must not be represented as fully working. No code repair was requested or applied.
